sql.propToolInverter.getAllForCompany: select i.id, i.inverter_name, i.company_id, i.archived from props.inverter i where i.company_id = :companyId and i.archived is not true order by i.inverter_name
sql.propToolInverter.update: update props.inverter set inverter_name = :inverterName where id = :id
sql.propToolInverter.delete: update props.inverter set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
